_comment: Flywheel's real pre-commit gates, declared for ~/.claude/scripts/sop_attest.py.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The attestation harness used to discover gates only by
reading package.json scripts. Flywheel has no package.json -- by design, its
validator IS the test suite -- so the harness found nothing, emitted
'no-gates-applicable', and wrote a PASS receipt indistinguishable from a
verified commit. A full session of commits was attested on '0 gate(s) ran'.
See .wiki/findings/2026-08-19-the-suite-was-red-on-main.md.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT GATED, named here rather than left implicit. A gate
set that silently omits coverage reads as 'everything was checked' when it
was not. These sections are excluded for RUNTIME, not because they do not
matter, and they must still be run by hand when their scene is touched:
cambridge  -- ~30 min on its own, and the sole reason the full run is ~37
min. It was specced to LOOK as dense as 73k voxels, not to
contain them; see the Cambridge 2 entry in STATUS.md.
chicago, speedInvariance, manhattan, upperManhattan, brooklyn, boston,
tokyo, scenesWinnable -- each is one or more full builds of a large city.
Touching js/voxelscene-<city>.js means running that city's section by hand:
FW_VALIDATE_SECTIONS=<name> node tools/validate.mjs
Never run a bare `node tools/validate.mjs` as a commit gate.
seoul, beijing, bangkok, mumbai are DELIBERATELY excluded from the routine
gate below for a different reason than the RUNTIME list above: each has a
known, accepted, currently-failing `probeRoadConflicts` remainder (hand-
authored landmark geometry sitting on a declared street, confirmed grounded
with no legitimate elevated-span exemption -- a scene-authoring design call,
not a mechanical bug). Baking a section that is known to FAIL into a PASS
gate would either block every future commit or force weakening the probe --
both wrong. See '.wiki/findings/REVIEW-2026-08-20-act-ii-scene-geometry-
road-water-conflicts.md', 'Resolution -- Filler-Loop Pass', for the exact
numbers (seoul 1744, beijing 812, bangkok 664, mumbai 160) and the fix.
Run them by hand until that finding is closed, same as the RUNTIME set:
FW_VALIDATE_SECTIONS=seoul,beijing,bangkok,mumbai node tools/validate.mjs
hongkong is NOT in this exception -- its own geometry defect (G11) is
fully fixed, so it is safe to include below.
Every section name below must also appear in the orchestrator's `groups`
array in tools/validate.mjs, or it is dormant there too.
